page.layout: One page of text in one column: a Hebrew-Latin lexicon page with entries set in hanging lines. No margin notes. The right edge of the scan cuts off some lines.

main_text.p: שׁוּעַ Vociferari. Pihel שִׁיַּע idem. Hiphil הִשִּׁיעַ Illinere, Incrustare, ex usu Chaldaico.
שׁוּעַ m. Idem: item Nobilitas, aut juxta Hebraeos, Divitiae.
שׁוּק Pihel שִׁקֵּק [?] Appetere: aliter vide in שִׁקֵּק. Hiphil הִשִּׁיק Excurrere, Exundare prae copia & plenitudine.
שׁוּק m. Platea, Vicus, Forum: sic dicta, quòd homines ibi Discurrant, à שָׁקַק: plurale, שׁוּקִים.
שׁוֹק f. Armus, Crus: plural. שׁוֹקִים Crura. Chald. שָׁקֵיהּ Crura ejus, Dan.2.33.
תִּשּׁוּקָה f. Appetens. תִּשְׁוּקָה f. Appetitus.
שׁוּר Cancre: item Contemplari, Respicere, Observare. Pihel שׁוּר idem. Hiphil הִשִּׁיר Cantare.
שִׁיר m. Canticum: plural. שִׁירִים. Fœmin. שִׁירָה, plur. שִׁירוֹת.
שׁוּר m. Inimicus, quasi Observator dictus: item

page.notes: Right-hand part of the page is cut off by the scan edge, so the ends of several lines are missing. Several Hebrew vowel-points and the Pihel forms in the entry for שׁוּק are doubtful and marked [?]. The Hebrew in the entry for שׁוּק (line 10) is hard to read at this scan quality. The footer "P 4," is a gathering signature.
